description: Maps a scanner finding type to the migration or remediation requirement it creates and the competencies (with required capability level) a person needs to meet that requirement. Draft for expert review: every rule is a methodological claim and none has been validated.
matching: A rule matches when match.finding_type equals the finding type, or when match.finding_type_prefix is a prefix of it. The first matching rule wins; rules are listed specific-first. A finding type that no rule matches must be listed in unmapped_by_design or positive_evidence, never silently ignored.

rules.requirement: Plan hybrid / post-quantum key establishment for TLS
rules.rationale: Classical-only key exchange is exposed to harvest-now-decrypt-later. Enabling a hybrid group such as X25519MLKEM768 needs TLS configuration skill (NET.4), hybrid deployment and agility (PQC.6), algorithm selection (PQC.3) and an understanding of the threat (PQC.1).

rules.requirement: Plan migration of certificate signatures to post-quantum algorithms
rules.rationale: A certificate signed with RSA or ECDSA must eventually move to ML-DSA or SLH-DSA. That needs PKI and certificate-lifecycle skill (CRYPTO.4), signature algorithm selection (PQC.3) and migration planning (PQC.8).
RSA key transport lets a later key compromise decrypt recorded traffic. Fixing it is a TLS configuration task (NET.4) that needs an understanding of ephemeral Diffie-Hellman (CRYPTO.3).
Disabling obsolete protocol versions is a TLS configuration task.
The server still accepts TLS 1.0 or 1.1; disabling them is the same TLS configuration task as an obsolete negotiated version.

rules.requirement: Maintain the certificate lifecycle (issuance, trust chain, renewal)
rules.rationale: Expired, expiring and untrusted certificates are lifecycle failures: PKI knowledge (CRYPTO.4) and key and certificate management (CRYPTO.5). Covers cert.expired, cert.expiring and cert.untrusted.
A risky service reachable from the internet calls for segmentation and filtering (NET.3) and an assessment of the threat it creates (SEC.2).

positive_evidence.note: Hybrid post-quantum key exchange is in use. Evidence of readiness, not a requirement.
Hybrid key exchange is supported but not preferred. Reported as evidence; the scanner does not track it as a finding.

unmapped_by_design.reason: HTTP security-header hygiene; low severity and not tracked as a finding. No competency requirement is claimed for now.
Mail and CA-authorisation DNS policy; low or info severity and not tracked as a finding. No competency requirement is claimed for now.
